record._status: OPEN — structural problem in a published library. Not a composition, and must not be lost in the composition queue.
record.problem: The entire Nav component family is defined inside a frame on the Compositions page that is labelled as a theme variant. Six components, fourteen with variants. These are the only component definitions anywhere on the Compositions page.
record.whyItMatters: Compositions are unpublished reference frames by decision (libraryRestructure2026_08_26c.settledDecisionsApplied.compositionsAreReferenceFrames). Component definitions living there means the Nav family is defined in a place the library treats as non-authoritative, and labelled as a variant of something rather than as itself.
record.consequence: Anyone building on nav is building on components whose home contradicts the page they sit on. Resolve before that happens.
record.nextStep: Determine where the Nav family should live and whether it is published, then move it. Verification to date is a count of what is there, not a plan for it.
record.relatedTo: fourCompositions2026_08_31.pageLayoutIntact — any move must preserve the hand-placed Compositions page layout.
